conjecture: Bare comonoids for the Dirichlet tensor in Poly (no ◁ structure) are exactly the FAMILIES OF MONOIDS: a container c = Σ_{s∈S} y^{M_s} with each direction set c[s] carrying an arbitrary monoid structure. Comultiplication forced diagonal on shapes, fibrewise binary op on directions; coassoc=associativity, counit=unitality. Comon(Cont,⊗,y) ≅ Fam(Mon^op); cocommutative ones = Fam(CMon^op). Answers the Poly/⊗-comonoid slice of Niu–Spivak Ch9 Q5 (open).
